notablePrerequisites:
Two +1/+1 counters among permanents you control.
2 mana available.
description:
Activate Ghave to remove a counter from a creature you control.
Create a Saproling.
Put a +1/+1 counter on it with Good-Fortune Unicorn's trigger.
Remove the counter from that Saproling to create a new Saproling.
Sacrifice the old Saproling to add {1}.
Use that mana to create another Saproling.
Repeat.
